Findings: OpenSSH is installed by default beginning with Windows Server 2025.
Installing OpenSSH Server creates and enables OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP for inbound TCP port 22.
Starting sshd and making it automatic are separate configuration steps.
Server configuration is read from %ProgramData%\ssh\sshd_config by default.
sshd reads configuration at service startup; changes require service restart.
First use of sshd automatically generates host key pairs.
Service host keys are stored under C:\ProgramData\ssh.

Preserve pre-existing service/firewall state and refuse removal after drift.

Require matching feature source/recovery before removal; observe Server 2025 preinstalled capability as a no-op.
